test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
A ﬁve members research group is to be chosen from the Cricketers Nitesh, Arun, Aditya and Mohseen and the Boxers Priya, Neha, Simran and Kiran. At least 3 cricketers must be in the group. However:

(i) Nitesh refuses to work with Mohseen.

(ii) Arun refuses to work with Priya.

(iii) Neha refuses to work with Simran.

(iv) Mohseen refuses to work with Neha.

If Arun is chosen, who else would have to be deﬁnitely in the group?
solution:
Arranging them according to the given information,

Five members have to be chosen, at least three cricketers must be in the group.

If Arun is chosen, Priya is not chosen.

Since, Arun is a cricketer there is a chance of selecting two other cricketers.

Aditya is definitely in the group, since he did not refuse to work with anybody.

Any one between Nitesh and Mohseen is selected, because Nitesh refuses to work with Mohseen.

So,

If Arun is chosen, Aditya would have to be deﬁnitely in the group.

Hence, “Aditya” is the correct answer.
